module.domain_quote: In the case of any taxpayer whose adjusted gross income for the taxable year exceeds the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b)
module.expression: min(100, 2 * ceildiv(adjusted_gross_income - section68_applicable_amount, 1250 if married_filing_separately else 2500))

inputs.meaning: The taxpayer's adjusted gross income for the taxable year, measured in whole dollars.
inputs.name: adjusted_gross_income
inputs.quote: the taxpayer's adjusted gross income for the taxable year

inputs.meaning: The applicable dollar amount in effect under section 68(b) for the taxpayer and taxable year, supplied from that external section.
inputs.name: section68_applicable_amount
inputs.quote: the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b)

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer is a married individual filing a separate return.
inputs.name: married_filing_separately
inputs.quote: a married individual filing a separate return

obligations.name: ordinary_increment
obligations.quote: the term "applicable percentage" means 2 percentage points for each $2,500 (or fraction thereof)

obligations.name: separate_return_increment
obligations.quote: In the case of a married individual filing a separate return, the preceding sentence shall be applied by substituting "$1,250" for "$2,500".

obligations.name: percentage_cap
obligations.quote: In no event shall the applicable percentage exceed 100 percent.

module.rule_quote: the term "applicable percentage" means 2 percentage points for each $2,500 (or fraction thereof) by which the taxpayer's adjusted gross income for the taxable year exceeds the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b). In the case of a married individual filing a separate return, the preceding sentence shall be applied by substituting "$1,250" for "$2,500". In no event shall the applicable percentage exceed 100 percent.
unresolved: Section 68(b) is referenced but not supplied, so the applicable amount for the relevant taxpayer and taxable year must be provided externally.
